content_of_post_to_comment: It’s amusing, when reading something written by an academic 70+ years ago, to see which quotations from non-English languages they will condescend to translate. The book I’m reading right now assumes I can read French and short bits of ancient Greek without translation, but holds my hand for Latin, Italian, and German. What went into these assumptions, I wonder, and were they true for the book’s initial audience?
